messages:
kiran: Heads up — onboarding check for SI + hardware partner (VoltScale). We need to lock roles, billing SKU mapping, AMI/container artifacts, and a joint announcement baseline. Who can take legal packaging?

marie: I can drive ops for marketplace assets. Need VoltScale contact for the AMI build and a primary for logos. @oliver can you confirm product bundle (trial vs paid) and suggested pricing model?

oliver: Product prefers a 14-day trial + pay-per-instance pricing for Dedicated. We should give customers the option to pick Hosted API or Dedicated in the same listing (two SKUs). Also need to pin a default model for the trial flow.

legal-qa: pinging legal. We'll need EULA + DPA + any export-control attestations for hardware integrations. Also check if VoltScale wants logo usage language in the MSA.

ana (Legal): I can take the EULA & DPA drafts. Also need a draft of the joint announcement language and any partner-provided MSA excerpts. Please send logos and marketing blurbs.

marie: VoltScale sent a partial asset pack. Logo link: https://files.redwood/volt-logo.svg. AMI IDs are pending but they started the bake. They also shared an example IAM role they want us to reference: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
    "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"}
  }]
}
```

oliver: IAM snippet looks fine for AWS; for GCP we'll need a service account binding example and for Azure a managed identity RBAC snippet. I'll draft both and attach to the SKU mapping doc.

partnerships-bot: Reminder: marketplace onboarding checklist updated (v2). See /doc/marketplace/onboard-v2 for the canonical checklist and role matrix.

kiran: Let's do a quick triage call tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: AMI/container artifacts, SKU/pricing mapping, legal artifacts, and announcement calendar. @ana (Legal) @marie please confirm availability.

ana (Legal): Confirmed. I'll upload a first-pass EULA and DPA by EOD today to the drive folder.

marie: I'll prepare the SKU spreadsheet and packaging doc and post to #partnerships-assets right after the call.

VoltScale-SA: Hi team — VoltScale confirms AMI bake started; will share AMI IDs and a container image manifest in ~48h. We can also provide a short partner blurb for the announcement.

marie: Great — action items captured: (1) oliver -> pricing SKU mapping + multi-SKU layout, (2) marie -> asset ingest + marketplace package, (3) ana -> EULA/DPA and announcement review, (4) VoltScale-SA -> AMI IDs & container manifest. I'll update the checklist and share a meeting invite.

kiran: Thanks all :thumbsup:
